rule.title: Assumed accounting balance can diverge from actual settlement after rounding

intent.attack_thesis: Fixed-point scaling and pricing rely on an assumed rounded balance while settlement or storage updates use a different actual amount, creating repeatable economic leakage.

reporting.title_template: Rounded assumed balance diverges from actual settlement
reporting.summary: Matches fixed-point floor scaling when pricing depends on an assumed balance and settlement uses a different actual amount, with deterministic arithmetic evidence.
reporting.user_summary: The contract's math may round one side of an accounting or pricing calculation differently from the amount it later settles in storage. In low-liquidity or repeated cases, that mismatch can leak value over time.
reporting.technical_summary: The detector matches fixed-point floor scaling and an invariant or pricing path that uses an assumed rounded balance while settlement or state update consumes a different actual amount. The attached arithmetic witness shows a concrete amount where rounding discards value in a way that can become economically material.
reporting.exploit_narrative: An attacker chooses amounts that land on a truncation boundary. The protocol prices or validates the action using a rounded assumption, but settles with a different effective quantity, allowing small but repeatable value extraction across repeated interactions.
exploit_preconditions: low liquidity or small amounts make discarded precision material
pricing or invariant path uses the rounded assumption
settlement or state update can consume a different actual amount
remediation_hints: align rounding direction with the protected asset side
ensure pricing and settlement consume the same effective quantity

preconditions: contract accepts fee-on-transfer or rebasing token

steps.action: transfer fee-on-transfer token to contract, triggering assumption mismatch
steps.expected_state: contract records assumed amount but actual amount is lower due to fee
withdraw succeeds for more than actual available, draining other depositors

witness_goal.success_condition: attacker extracts more value than deposited by exploiting assumed vs actual balance divergence
